evidence: Labeled 'Tests', modifies benchmark files in 'src/bench/', and extracts shared benchmark utility helpers into 'bench/wallet_bench_util.h'.
rationale: Adds benchmark coverage for wallets with large histories of spent outputs to profile balance calculations and evaluate optimizations such as #27865. It also refactors synthetic block generation into a reusable helper header 'src/bench/wallet_bench_util.h'.
